system.description:
The intensity of the [Decay] you inflict is increased by +20. If your attack triggers [Vulnerability (Poison)], treat the intensity as double. A short sword with a black handle and a bright red gemstone that catches the eye. Said to have the power of a giant-killing scorpion's single strike, it possesses magic that transforms the wielder's poison into a deadly toxin.

Vermilion-Lacquered Arrow [Core Material] (500G) + Dirk (640G) + Deadly Poison (Advanced) (250G) ×3 + Decay Poison (Advanced) (280G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 17] (280G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (790G)
